question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in chronological order the events in which a person began holding the team's president or CEO post, up to and including the start of Kathy Betty's tenure as co-owner and CEO.
why_needs_multiple: Two different people started the top executive post in the chain before Betty's tenure, and both starts are needed.
criterion: events recording a person starting to hold the team's president/COO or co-owner-and-CEO post, up to the start of Betty's tenure

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in chronological order the trades of players or draft picks that the team made from its expansion draft until the end of June (the three trades made on the same day may be in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Five separate trades or pick exchanges in the first season form one chain that must be listed in full.
criterion: trades or pick exchanges of players or draft picks with other teams, from the expansion draft to the end of June 2008

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in chronological order the trades of players or draft picks the team made in the calendar year when Michael Cooper was hired as head coach.
why_needs_multiple: Three trades in one calendar year form a chain that must be listed in full.
criterion: trades of players or draft picks with other teams in the calendar year Michael Cooper was hired as head coach

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in chronological order the events in which the team began playing its home games at a venue, including its first venue.
why_needs_multiple: Five venue starts across the franchise history form one chain that must be listed in full.
criterion: events in which home games begin at a venue (first venue, moves to a venue, return to a venue); the October 2019 announcement of the College Park move is not counted because it is the same move as the 2021 start
